--- a/toolformer_filter.py
+++ b/toolformer_filter.py
@@ -13,4 +13,41 @@
 ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
     """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
 
-    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
+    # Validate inputs
+    if not isinstance(logp_with_result, np.ndarray) or logp_with_result.ndim != 2:
+        raise ValueError("logp_with_result must be a 2D numpy array")
+    if not isinstance(logp_call_only, np.ndarray) or logp_call_only.ndim != 2:
+        raise ValueError("logp_call_only must be a 2D numpy array")
+    if not isinstance(logp_no_call, np.ndarray) or logp_no_call.ndim != 2:
+        raise ValueError("logp_no_call must be a 2D numpy array")
+    if logp_with_result.shape != logp_call_only.shape or logp_with_result.shape != logp_no_call.shape:
+        raise ValueError("All input arrays must have the same shape")
+    if logp_with_result.size == 0:
+        raise ValueError("Input arrays must not be empty")
+    if not np.all(np.isfinite(logp_with_result)) or not np.all(np.isfinite(logp_call_only)) or not np.all(np.isfinite(logp_no_call)):
+        raise ValueError("All input values must be finite")
+    if np.any(logp_with_result > 0) or np.any(logp_call_only > 0) or np.any(logp_no_call > 0):
+        raise ValueError("All input values must be nonpositive")
+    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
+    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number")
+
+    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape
+    t = np.arange(future_horizon, dtype=np.float64)
+    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
+    sum_weights = raw_weights.sum()
+    if sum_weights == 0:
+        normalized_weights = np.ones(future_horizon) / future_horizon
+    else:
+        normalized_weights = raw_weights / sum_weights
+
+    L_plus = -np.sum(normalized_weights[np.newaxis, :] * logp_with_result, axis=1)
+    L_call_only = -np.sum(normalized_weights[np.newaxis, :] * logp_call_only, axis=1)
+    L_no_call = -np.sum(normalized_weights[np.newaxis, :] * logp_no_call, axis=1)
+
+    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no_call, L_call_only)
+    margin = L_minus - L_plus
+    keep = margin >= tau_filter
+
+    return keep, margin
